feature_name: Shadow API Discovery no-P4SA setup requirement
summary: Shadow API Discovery preview can be enabled without creating separate Private Google Access (P4SA) permissions.
extended_definition: Shadow API Discovery preview can be enabled without creating separate Private Google Access (P4SA) permissions.

evidence_snippets: Overview Preview — Shadow API Discovery This feature is subject to the "Pre-GA Offerings Terms" in the General Service Terms section of the Service Specific Terms .
